# Feature flags
{: .no_toc }

See, and later change, the client feature flags (CLIENT-ARCHITECTURE §10).
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

This screen is part of the **web Hub's Console** and isn't in the Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS or Android apps yet (specs OPEN-QUESTIONS #27).
{: .note }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `CFG-02` |
| **Route** | `/ops/config/flags` |
| **Who can use it** | operations.view (read), operations.manage (write, after G10) |
| **Kind** | settings |
| **Available in** | Web Hub only (Console M4 (web only)) |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| Flags | toggle list | every flag in CLIENT-ARCHITECTURE §10 | read-only until G11; then editable and audited |
| Platform settings | settings rows | signup open, read-only maintenance mode, per-key rate-limit overrides ([G12 #49](https://github.com/CompositeCode/substratalapps.com/issues/49)) | hidden until the API has them |

## For developers

Loads: until [G11 #48](https://github.com/CompositeCode/substratalapps.com/issues/48): the web build's `/config/flags.json`; after: the API's settings endpoint

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
